memorial.name: Caroline
memorial.epitaph: I… don't think I'm coming back. The wild. 40 days… The journal — keep it. Please keep writing.

memorial.name: Elena
memorial.epitaph: If someone's reading this in my handwriting — I didn't make it back. The wild. 27 days I held it. The notes are good. Keep writing.

memorial.name: Oscar
memorial.epitaph: The wild. 54d. Journal's yours now. The notes hold.
